visualCharacteristics.description: Article teasers with image, category tag, linked title and Read More link, in a 1/2/3-column grid
visualCharacteristics.source: Dynamic list: each item links to an article detail page and carries a category tag.

contentPattern.structure: Cell 1: image (optionally linked). Cell 2: category paragraph, linked title paragraph, Read More link
rows: Category paragraph 'Events', linked title paragraph, 'Read More' link

reuseGuidance: Use for article listings; the image is linked to the article automatically when not already linked.
